Subject: Prelaunch ops sync — final alignment for AstraTech pilot

Team —

With the AstraTech pilot kickoff two weeks out, I want one consolidated alignment thread so leadership has a clear read for the QBR. We need short, concrete status updates from each function by EOD Friday. Specifically:

- GTM / Sales (Marissa): go-to-market channel readiness, playbooks, demo cadence, initial success metrics and forecast.
- Enablement / Docs (Monica & Laura): customer-facing playbooks, quickstart, and internal training schedule. Are we shipping the enablement pack with the first release?
- Pricing / Legal (Markus): final pricing table, SLA language we will present to AstraTech, and any procurement constraints.
- Support / SRE (Jonas): runbook, escalation matrix, and expected MTTR targets for pilot.

Please attach any owner documents (checklist, pricing draft, runbooks) and call out any open blockers. I will consolidate and share a one-pager for execs and QBR prep.

Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/ASTRA-PL-23 (prelaunch checklist)
HubSpot: HS-40219

Thanks — short bullets preferred.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Business Operations
Redwood Inference
